name: Network Infrastructure Policy
description:
Thematic policy for network and infrastructure identifiers: IP addresses, MAC addresses, URLs and hostnames, DNS records, SSH fingerprints, HTTP cookies, and VPN configuration data. Membership is the whole network category.

Renamed from policy.networking-global in D17 — the "-global" suffix belonged to the old jurisdictional taxonomy, where a name had to say which policies were NOT jurisdictional. Every theme is global now.

Scope: Network infrastructure data — global, category-driven
